title: David’s Census and Judgment

questions.question: What did David order Joab to do that was sinful?
options: Number the people of Israel and Judah
questions.correctAnswer: Number the people of Israel and Judah
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:2 (ESV): "...Go through all the tribes of Israel... and number the people..."

questions.question: Who tried to dissuade David from counting the people?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:3 (ESV): "But Joab said to the king, 'May the LORD your God add to the people... but why does my lord the king delight in this thing?'"

questions.question: Which prophet came to David after the census?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:11 (ESV): "...the word of the LORD came to the prophet Gad, David's seer..."

questions.question: What three choices of punishment was David given?
options: Famine, fleeing from foes, or pestilence
questions.correctAnswer: Famine, fleeing from foes, or pestilence
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:13 (ESV): "...three years of famine... or three months of fleeing... or three days of pestilence..."

questions.question: Which punishment did David choose?
options: Pestilence (falling into the hand of the Lord)
questions.correctAnswer: Pestilence (falling into the hand of the Lord)
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:14 (ESV): "...Let us fall into the hand of the LORD, for his mercy is great..."

questions.question: How many men died in the pestilence?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:15 (ESV): "...and there died of the people from Dan to Beersheba 70,000 men."

questions.question: Where did the angel stop destroying Jerusalem?
options: At the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite
questions.correctAnswer: At the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:16 (ESV): "...The angel of the LORD was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite."

questions.question: What did David buy from Araunah?
options: The threshing floor and the oxen
questions.correctAnswer: The threshing floor and the oxen
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:24 (ESV): "...So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen..."

questions.question: How much did David pay for the threshing floor and oxen?
Why did David insist on paying Araunah?
options: He would not offer burnt offerings that cost him nothing
questions.correctAnswer: He would not offer burnt offerings that cost him nothing
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:24 (ESV): "...I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God that cost me nothing."

questions.question: How long did it take Joab to number the people?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:8 (ESV): "...they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days."

questions.question: What was the number of valiant men in Israel?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:9 (ESV): "In Israel there were 800,000 valiant men who drew the sword..."

questions.question: What was the number of men in Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:9 (ESV): "...and the men of Judah were 500,000."

questions.question: What did Araunah offer to give David for the sacrifice?
options: Oxen for burnt offering, threshing sledges and yokes for wood
questions.correctAnswer: Oxen for burnt offering, threshing sledges and yokes for wood
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:22 (ESV): "...Here are the oxen for the burnt offering and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood."

questions.question: God's anger was kindled against Israel, so he incited David against them saying, "______"
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 24:1 (ESV): "...he incited David against them, saying, 'Go, number Israel and Judah.'"

key_verse_text: But the king said to Araunah, “No, but I will buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God that cost me nothing.” (ESV)
